title: Grateful Dead Live at Augusta Civic Center on 1984-10-11
lineage: MAC > Nak CR7A w/ azimuth adjusted > Korg MR-1000 @ 5.8mhz > FLAC 24/96; Edited & Mastered in Audacity by Joe Noel > Flac 24/96; Checksum & tags created in xACT; 24 bit to 16 bit with MusicConverter using sox-14-4-2
source: billydee recording (patched out of): Neumann km84i's > Sony TC-D5M > master audio cassette (FOB); Larry Sellers & the Philly Crew Direct Stream Digital (DSD)

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording that captures a strong first set highlighted by Peggy‑O, Mama Tried and Big River, while the second set stalls on Touch of Grey and Dewiminna.
ai_review.review: The front‑of‑board audience source provides decent clarity with a slightly narrow midrange, making it listenable but not pristine. Musically the show shines in the first set – Peggy‑O, Mama Tried and Big River are praised as standout performances – whereas the second set is deemed average, with Touch of Grey and Dewiminna described as vapid despite a solid Black Peter jam.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is strong in the first set but weaker in the second, and recording quality is good though not outstanding; combined weighted score yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑board audience tape with missing mids (1.5–7 kHz), narrower frequency range and less clarity than some soundboard sources, but offers a wide overall spectrum and is less fatiguing once EQ adjusted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set earns a B+ with tight, energetic performances; second set drops to a C, feeling average for ’84 despite a strong ending jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Loses an entire verse in Shakedown but otherwise solid playing.
